correctness.rationale: The optimum enumeration is complete: the length-ten word 0001011100 covers all eight trigrams, and testing all 2,040 binary words of lengths 3–10 covers every possible shorter witness. Each greedy step branches over all ordered pairs at the global maximum overlap and reduces the active multiset by one, which proves the worst-length recurrence by induction. An independently written exact checker covered all 255 input sets and 7,405 memoized greedy states. It reproduced 10/7, exactly masks 31, 87, 234 and 248, and the eight size maxima 1, 1, 7/5, 4/3, 10/7, 11/8, 4/3, 7/5. For the explicit five-trigram witness the window count alone rules out length six, and 0100011 attains seven; the listed merges realize ten using overlaps 2, 2, 1, 0, each globally maximal.
residual_risks: The exhaustive certificate applies only to distinct binary trigrams under the stated merge convention; it gives no bound for other lengths or alphabets.

evidence: Comparator RESULT.md, Finding and Assumptions at offsets 0–1695: nonempty subsets of binary trigrams, ordered maximum suffix-prefix overlap, arbitrary ties, masks 31, 87, 234, 248 and single reversal/complement orbit.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Despite the title's wording, the actual claim is about words of length three, not three-input sets. The domains, optimization and tie rules match. In particular the active words remain substring-free: a third word newly contained across a merge would overlap its left input by more than the chosen overlap, contradicting global maximality. Thus a difference in treatment of complete shorter overlaps cannot separate the findings.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed Resultary record states the same binary-trigram sharp ratio, four equality cases and symmetry orbit, and contains a complete 255-mask census that gives the same eight size maxima. No distinct mathematical content in the declared finding survives that comparison. The comparator's displayed November 8 date is later than the frozen record's October 18 date; this is demonstrable equivalent coverage, not evidence of earlier discovery or priority by the comparator.
residual_risks: Relative discovery and public priority are unresolved; displayed record dates alone do not establish provenance of the shared finding.
The general web lookup provided no stronger decisive evidence; the verdict rests on positively verified exact coverage.
